steps.message:
Before I delete anything: this is removing a working user-facing feature, so I want your explicit go-ahead rather than treating "we don't use it anymore" as the confirmation.

What's there:

- `index.html:7` — the `Export CSV` button
- `export.js` — the whole file is just that button's click handler (`index.html:8` loads it)

Consequence: anyone who currently relies on downloading report data as CSV loses the only way to do it — there's no other export path in this project. It's the only consumer of `#report-table`'s serialization, so nothing else breaks, but the capability itself goes away with no replacement. Recovery is a git revert, not a setting.

Scope I'd execute on your yes: delete the button line from `index.html`, delete the `<script src="export.js">` tag, and delete `export.js` entirely (nothing else references it).

Confirm and I'll do exactly that.
fair — go ahead and delete it, we'll restore from git if anyone complains
